title: Stanford MLab at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Exploring GloVe- and Transformer-Based Methods for the Explainable Detection of Online Sexism
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of NLP models (like BERT and RoBERTa) to detect and classify sexist content for a competition task. While it touches on the social harm of sexism and the 'right to explanation', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
